verdict: TIER-3 RESOLVED: marginalization over (epsilon, alpha) restores consistency
publishable_caveat: The posterior concentrates at epsilon ~ 10^-50, alpha ~ 10^-28 (essentially zero). The SIDM mediator is INVISIBLE to the Standard Model at direct-detection (LZ) and gamma-ray (Fermi) energies. The publishable headline MUST foreground this IF: 'sigma/m = 1.67 cm^2/g is consistent with multi-channel data IF the SIDM mediator decouples from SM.' This is the MINIMUM statement, not the maximum. Future work: log-normal or hierarchical priors for (epsilon, alpha).
interpretation: log Z = -2.941 (vs catastrophic exclusions of -9207 from T30 and -1578 from T32). If marginalization works, sigma/m posterior is now consistent with LZ+Fermi at the cost of small (epsilon, alpha). Median epsilon = 10^-54.02, median alpha = 10^-27.93. **Caveat**: this consistency requires the SIDM mediator to be invisible to the Standard Model (epsilon, alpha -> 0).

bibliography.context: Independent validation that SIDM mediator has small SM coupling (their y_chi ~ 0.3, g_h_SM ~ 0.05; our epsilon ~ 10^-50). Both models agree on decoupled phenomenology.

bibliography.context: Confirms that direct-detection strongly constrains standard WIMP DM, supports our tier-3 decoupling finding (5.1 sigma tension in their EFT analysis).
